body: Enhance my todo app, I want to add filters only see completed, incomplete and all tasks. I would like to add a due date. I would like to add tags to my ticket and filter the tasks by available tags.

comments.body:
Picking this up 👀

**Ask:** filters for completed / incomplete / all tasks, due dates, and tags with filtering by tag.

**Built in PR #8:** https://github.com/karachiwaladev/contour-jonas-oct-2026-eng-muhammad-anas/pull/8
- Due date on each task, a list sorted by due date, and overdue tasks highlighted
- Tags entered as chips, with multi-tag filtering (match any)
- All / Incomplete / Completed filters that combine with the tag filter
- Inline editing of the title, due date and tags

Tested in headless Microsoft Edge with 18/18 checks passing. The full checklist and screenshots are in the PR. This ticket closes automatically when the PR is merged.

**Browser verification for this ticket (headless Microsoft Edge, via the DevTools protocol)**

PR #8 is merged. Here's the verification evidence with screenshots, checked against the plan that was approved before the build:
- [x] All / Incomplete / Completed filters work, on their own and combined with tags
- [x] Due dates: the list is sorted soonest first with undated tasks last, and overdue tasks are highlighted
- [x] Tags are added as chips, and the multi-tag filter shows tasks with any selected tag
- [x] Inline editing of title, date and tags works; Esc cancels
- [x] Everything persists after a reload, with no console errors (18/18 checks)
